newsitem.title: UK: Dart Group says to buy two Airbus aircraft.
newsitem.headline: Dart Group says to buy two Airbus aircraft.

text.p: Channel Express (Air Services), a member of Dart Group Plc, will acquire two Airbus A300B4 aircraft for up to 19.53 million stg, the group said on Thursday.
The acquisition of the two aircraft will increase the group's fleet of A300B4 freighter aircraft to three.
"The introduction of the Airbus A300B4...will considerably enhance the company's potential to take full advantage of the forecast growth in the air cargo market," the company said.
The A300B4 can carry some 42 tonnes of freight on stage lengths of 2,200 nautical miles.

Dart also announced rise in pretax profits to 4.64 million stg in the year to March 1997, from 4.03 million in the previous year. Turnover was up to 72.1 million stg from 69.0 million while earnings per share inched ahead to 19.3 pence from 17.3 pence.
The company recommended a final dividend of 4.4 pence making a total dividend of 6.5 pence per share.
